thread:
jamie_support: FYI - multiple customers reporting model regressions after today's canary rollout (~06:30 UTC). They see outdated product copy returned for prompts that used to include new fields. Filing SUP-3342 and SUP-3343.

noah_customer: Confirmed from our side. Two of our requests are returning the old JSON schema (missing `warranty_period`) even though model version in header is 2.3.1. Happens intermittently.

jamie_support: Thanks @noah_customer — can you paste a minimal repro request?

noah_customer: Here's the curl we used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"product-describer-2","prompt":"Describe product X with warranty_period","max_tokens":200}'
```
Response sometimes contains old schema:
```
{"name":"Product X","description":"...","deprecated_field":"old"}
```

priya_ml: Did they hit a routing fallback? Which model alias resolved?

jamie_support: We saw headers: X-Redwood-Model: product-describer-2, X-Redwood-Model-Tag: canary-2026-03-16, X-Redwood-Prefix: prefix_v7

alex_eng_runtime: :eyes: I'm seeing a pattern in the logs. When the prefix hash used to compute KV cache key omits the rollout tag, old cached completion can be returned even if model tag changed. Example trace from node srv-12: 
```
cache_key computed: sha256(prefix_v7 + model_family_hash)
expected key: sha256(prefix_v7 + model_family_hash + rollout_tag)
```
We introduced a normalization change during the canary: rollout_tag not included in prefix normalization for batched requests.

deploy-bot: canary deploy 2.3.1 -> product-describer-2 completed at 2026-03-16T06:31:50Z (canary nodes: srv-10..srv-14)

priya_ml: That would explain mismatched outputs. If the KV cache key didn't include the canary tag, nodes on canary could hit pre-existing prefix entries. Repro idea: make two requests with the same user_prefix but different model_tag and see if second returns old completion.

jamie_support: Repro steps I ran locally: 1) call endpoint with header X-Redwood-Prefix: user:acct:42 + model_tag=A -> got new output; 2) redeploy model_tag=B (canary) -> call again with same prefix -> sometimes return output from A.

alex_eng_runtime: Ok quick plan: 1) force prefix cache flush on canary nodes (srv-10..srv-14) 2) roll back prefix normalization change in 2.3.2 patch or include rollout_tag in cache key 3) run golden prompt suite across canary.

jamie_support: Flushing caches now for affected nodes. Running flush command:
```
for node in srv-10 srv-11 srv-12 srv-13 srv-14; do 
  ssh $node "rdwctl cache purge --prefix user:acct:42"
done
```

alex_eng_runtime: Also pushed a hotfix branch that forces cache_version++ for the prefix layer; will promote to canary in ~15m once smoke passes.

noah_customer: After your flush the last two requests look correct. Thanks. Do you expect further user-visible regressions?

priya_ml: If we fix key construction and increment cache version, the mismatch should stop. We should also add an integration test: compute cache_key for given prefix+tag combos and verify uniqueness across model_tag changes.

jamie_support: I'll keep SUP-3342 open and add notes + TTL window we saw (~4 minutes). Tagging SEs for follow-up.

alex_eng_runtime: Patch promoted to canary-2.3.2-canary01 at 1799010400. Monitoring logs for cache hits/misses and schema mismatch.

deploy-bot: canary promote completed 2026-03-16T07:22:10Z

jamie_support: Closing loop for now — two customers confirmed fixes. Will re-open if we see post-fix recurrences. :thumbsup:
